about: Differences the parity suite EXPECTS rather than flags. Each entry is a BOUND, not an exemption: the test fails if the field comes back into agreement (the entry is stale — delete it) and fails if the difference grows past what the stated cause can account for. `scenario: "*"` means the difference is a property of the code rather than of the case. `maxRelative` is the measured difference rounded up to one significant figure.

divergences.cause: numVC: openisd's Driver#derive() autofills numVC = 1 for a record that omits it, so slot 23 reads C (the app supplied it). WinISD pins that slot E, asserting a human entered a value nobody typed. Ruled 2026-08-13 'there was a winisd bug here - obviously dont replicate that', so a red row here would be the suite being wrong, not the app.

packages/engine/src/air.ts winisdAir() anchors WinISD's measured pair (WINISD_MEASURED_C_REF) to the caller's tempK via the moist-air model's ratio (QO88), so it moves with temperature; the harness passes each scenario's own env. WinISD's compatibility pair comes from its app-level Options environment, which these project-env scenarios never touch — env-t-303's stored c/roo are byte-identical to its 293.15 K twin env-rh-30. Measured 1.81e-2 relative at 303.15 K.

Same mechanism as air.c: winisdAir() scales WINISD_MEASURED_RHO_REF by the moist-air density ratio at the scenario's tempK; WinISD's app-level pair does not move with a project's temperature. Measured 3.51e-2 relative at 303.15 K.

The driver's own [Driver].c field, filled by OpenISDDriver's #deriveEnteredOnly() when unentered: the pure CIPM-2007 moist-air value at the reference environment, 4.1e-6 relative from WinISD's stored literal (343.684120962153 m/s). Driver derivation does not use winisdAir()'s anchored model, so this leg still differs where the harness's own air.c/air.roo (which do) now agree.
Same mechanism as the 'c' entry, for [Driver].roo.

SPLmaxLF's p20 term is driven by driverC()/driverRho(), so the live-CIPM-vs-stored-literal c/roo difference propagates into it at a much smaller relative magnitude (SPLmaxLF depends on c/roo only weakly).
Reference efficiency no = (4π²/c³)·Fs³·Vas/Qes is cubic in c, so the live-CIPM-vs-stored-literal difference in c (≈4.14e-6) is amplified roughly 3x here.

fLe has no route from a scenario's 22-key .wdr: openisd never computes it (no formula takes fLe from the T/S set) and no scenario ever enters it, so cell() reads N. Every golden marks the slot E with fLe=0 regardless — WinISD's own 'declined-but-defaulted' convention for a field it opened from a foreign file rather than its own New dialog (contrast drivers/sample/winisd/john-all-defaults.wdr, a real New->Save, which marks the same class of field N). Confirmed on every golden with a ParState (all but solve-from-mms-cms, which has none) — see bugs/BUG_20260813_parstate-writer-emits-n-for-the-34-slots-the-driver-does-not-model.md 'Reverified 2026-08-14'.
KLe — same mechanism as ParState[6] (fLe): no scenario enters it, nothing derives it, WinISD's declined-but-defaulted convention marks it E anyway.

Xlim has no WDR key at all (ParState-only slot, packages/design/winisd/parstate.ts) and no scenario states it, so openisd's writer never has a route to mark it. Same declined-but-defaulted WinISD convention as ParState[6].

Slot 20 has no identified WDR key (packages/design/winisd/parstate.ts POS_TO_WDRKEY[20] = null) — openisd has no field to mark E or C for it under any circumstance. WinISD's declined-but-defaulted convention marks it E anyway.
alfaVC (thermal coefficient) is carried metadata only — no scenario enters it and no formula derives it from the T/S set. Same declined-but-defaulted WinISD convention as ParState[6].
Rt (thermal resistance) — same mechanism as ParState[29]: carried-only, never entered by a scenario, never derived.
Ct (thermal capacitance) — same mechanism as ParState[29]: carried-only, never entered by a scenario, never derived.

Mcost = Rme*(1 + Xmax/min(Hc,Hg)) is undefined at Hc=Hg=0 (14 of 15 scenarios), so cell() correctly reads N there while WinISD's declined-but-defaulted convention marks it E. gap-geometry (Hc=12mm, Hg=6mm) is the control: both sides mark it C there, so this entry is never consulted for that scenario.
Thick (cone thickness) — carried dimension metadata, never entered by a scenario, never derived. Same declined-but-defaulted WinISD convention as ParState[6].
Depth — same mechanism as ParState[38]: carried dimension metadata, never entered, never derived.
MagDepth — same mechanism as ParState[38].
Magnet (magnet diameter) — same mechanism as ParState[38].
Basket — same mechanism as ParState[38].
Outer — same mechanism as ParState[38].
Vcd (voice-coil diameter) — same mechanism as ParState[38].
DVol (basket displacement) — same mechanism as ParState[38].
Slot 46 has no identified WDR key (packages/design/winisd/parstate.ts POS_TO_WDRKEY[46] = null), same as slot 20 — openisd has no field to mark for it under any circumstance.

c (speed of sound) — drivers/sample/winisd/john-all-defaults.wdr (a real New->Save with nothing typed) marks this slot C, matching openisd's own autofill-to-the-engine-constant. Every parity golden instead marks it E: these goldens were produced by opening a foreign 22-key .wdr with no ParState line and letting WinISD solve+save, not New->Save, and WinISD's declined-but-defaulted convention treats the frozen air pair as 'entered' on that path. The VALUE agrees exactly (compared separately as air.c); only the mark differs.
roo (air density) — same mechanism as ParState[47].
